highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 incorporates upstream Skia m158 bug fixes.
highlights_body: The shared hash-code helper in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp also changes its per-process seed source while preserving within-process stability.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer with upstream fixes from the chrome/m158 branch while retaining milestone 158.

bullets.lead: Use operating-system randomness for hash initialization
bullets.detail: The shared HashCode helper in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now uses RandomNumberGenerator for its per-process seed. Hashes remain randomized between processes and stable within a process. First use now loads System.Security.Cryptography and has additional startup cost.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Updated shared hash-code initialization to use cryptographic randomness and added analyzer checks for randomness in shipped code.
